title: runtime: the confirmation-gated flow-start refusal of an AI service account carries no details.reason service_account, while every action door now does
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

Found by area S3 while delivering #33690 (PR #34202, out-of-scope finding class b).

PR #34202 makes every action door's refusal of an AI service account carry `details.reason: service_account` (from `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REFUSAL_REASONS` in spec). The gated flow-start refusal in `packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts` (`confirmationGatedStartRefusal`) does not carry it, so a client that branches on the reason cannot treat a flow start like an action.

**Reach:** not measured at a public door; this was found by reading the source only. The fix first measures whether the refusal reaches a door (REST or MCP flow start), then adds the reason and a parity pin.

Blocked-by: #34202

Prior rulings read: the #33690 ruling.

Dedupe: an open-issue search for `confirmationGatedStartRefusal` found only #33690.
